title: Investigate and respond to incidents by email
summary: Have an agent investigate a Clockwork halt, author its email, and handle each user reply as one intervention while retaining the exchange and Nucleus reference.
use_when: A Clockwork halt must be investigated, incident correspondence inspected, or a recognized reply handled as one authorized intervention.
do_not_use_when: The user needs another recipient, sender authentication, continuous repair, or a replacement for product-owned recovery.
outcome: One retained incident exchange and its email submission outcome, with Nucleus activity referenced rather than copied.
effects: Agent work can inspect and operate current-user Cell systems and send incident email under the authorized exchange. Configuration, scheduling, maintenance and installation have their documented separate effects.

Codex weekly quota is an expected admission pause. Pending requester work is retained without a Clockwork abend; EMT sends one durable condition notice directly through Email without a Nucleus job. Existing deadlines, failure halts and operator pauses remain independent.
authority: EMT owns correspondence and its transport progress. Nucleus owns execution; products own results.
success: Interpret the exact operation receipt. A send succeeds at provider acceptance; an intervention needs product evidence.
failure_and_recovery: Keep exact pending request and mail identities. Preserve unknown outcomes. Do not create another agent attempt automatically. Use the complete manual for cancellation, deadlines, maintenance and notification recovery.
privacy: Correspondence and pointers remain private and retained. Nucleus and email providers keep separate copies. Logs and ordinary status omit bodies.
does_not_authorize: Unrequested recipients, unrelated mutations, automatic failed-job replacement, or clearing a newer Clockwork halt.

consumers.statement: The current user and authorized local EMT worker or operator.

preconditions.statement: Compatible installed Clockwork feed and notification handoff, Email send/receive, and Nucleus local-execution capabilities; configured receiving account and explicit operation authority.

Prompt preparation requires initialized private Bazaar state and a complete cell.prompts.emt selection. The default database is ~/.local/share/bazaar/bazaar.sqlite3; callers accept an absolute CELL_BAZAAR_DATABASE override. Reads fail without creating state or using embedded fallback text.

inputs.statement: Incident identity and metadata, installed contract and source pointers, current received email and preceding correspondence. Configuration selects absolute provider paths, Cell and agent directories and an accepted model.

outputs.statement: Incident and exchange reads expose retained correspondence and Nucleus IDs. Status and worker output expose counts and waiting codes. Email text is agent-authored except deterministic failure notices.

data_semantics.statement: An exchange is correspondence, not an operation ledger. Nucleus job completion is runtime evidence. Product state determines intervention success; Email receipts prove provider acceptance only.

identity_and_units.statement: Clockwork IDs identify incidents, provider IDs deduplicate received mail, RFC Message-IDs thread replies, and UUID exchange/job IDs correlate Nucleus. Deadlines use Unix seconds; content limits use bytes.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Bounded pages advance only after capture; cursors do not acknowledge provider mail.
No inbox completeness, authenticated sender identity, model accuracy, timer latency or final-delivery deadline is promised.

access.statement: Agents require Nucleus invocation policy version two and workspace-unrestricted for local execution with unrestricted current-user filesystem, process, local socket, and network access. Codex sandbox restrictions and approval prompts are disabled. Default cwd is the user home. They discover public operations through Chancery; EMT has no operation adapter layer. Diagnosis-only behavior is an instruction. Sender verification is deferred.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Persist exact request before submission; retain job ID and digest after admission. Freeze outgoing mail before claiming initial delivery. One basic sender or EMT claim owns the initial alert. No automatic replacement agent job. Uncertain external actions require inspection through Nucleus and the owning product.

EMT resolves cell.prompts.emt to exact component versions before new preparation and freezes rendered instructions with its saved request. Retries retain that selection; later edits do not rewrite saved work.

operational_limits.statement: One agent assignment; one 100-incident feed page and at most four 100-record receiving pages per pass; 300/900-second active limits within absolute five/15-minute deadlines; 256-byte subjects and 64 KiB bodies; at most two transport invocations five minutes apart within 23 hours.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: EMT schema one and Clockwork routing sidecar version one are separate from release versions. Old pinned Clockwork brokers must be replaced before routing is enabled.
No future support lifetime or retention horizon is promised.

Selection version 1 and its exact referenced immutable text versions preserve the migration baseline. Caller rendering and agent authority remain EMT-owned; runtime reads never import missing seed text.

reliances.statement: Clockwork owns incidents, notification ownership and worker scheduling. Its shared service-health threshold establishes a new scheduling halt and alert eligibility together; healthy or inactive checks clear a pending episode and established halts retain their exact approval rule.
Nucleus owns agent invocation and durable activity.
Agents select the affected product contracts through Chancery; those products own recovery and success.
Bazaar supplies immutable text versions. The caller owns selection JSON, rendering, permissions, and execution; a string supplies no additional authority.
EMT worker admission, configuration, schedule and retained installation state follow their own service contract.
Shared quota observations defer new model work and drive independent frozen condition notices.
